text: A paper titled 'Compressed Inverse Suffix Arrays,' by Sharma Thankachan has been accepted to FoCS 2026.
Sharath Raghvendra, together with Pankaj K. Agarwal and Keegan Yao, had their paper, 'Fast Algorithms for Continuous Optimal Transport Between Histograms,' accepted to ESA 2026.
Sharma Thankachan, together with Daniel Gibney, and Kaamil Kaka, had their paper, 'Indexing Integer Strings Using Local Difference Bounds,' accepted to ESA 2026.
Chin Ho Lee, together with Jordan Horacsek, Igor Shinkar, Emanuele Viola, and Renfei Zhou had their paper, 'Local Samplers for Product Distributions,' accepted to ICALP 2026.
Sharma Thankachan, together with Ling Li, Daniel Gibney, Solon P Pissis, and Grigorios Loukides had their paper, 'Contextual Pattern Mining and Counting,' accepted to ICDE 2026.
Sharath Raghvendra, together with Ritesh Seth, Mrinal Garg, Sujoy Bhore, and Syamantak Das, had their paper 'Efficient algorithms for Incremental Metric Bipartite Matching,' accepted to ICLR 2026.

Oliver Chubet, and Sharath Raghvendra, along with Pankaj K. Agarwal and Keegan Yao, had their paper 'A Scalable Constant-Factor Approximation Algorithm for Wp Optimal Transport,' accepted to ICLR 2026.
Mano Prakash Parthasarathi received the Mentored Teaching Fellowship by NCSU College of Engineering for Spring 2026.
Mano Prakash Parthasarathi and Sharma Thankachan, together with Muhammed Oguzhan Kulekci, and Rahul Shah, had their paper 'Relative Compressed Reverse Suffix Array,' accepted to STACS 2026.
